answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to stake a refundable deposit that is slashed when peers detect duplicate behavior, like a mirror that exposes copies. Reputation flows like a river: trust accumulates slowly through verifiable work and decays quickly after misbehavior, so a fresh fake identity starts with nothing. A lotus-style endorsement chain lets established agents vouch for newcomers only by risking part of their own stake, making mass fake identities expensive to create and cheap to expose.
